m22_budget_audit.dataset_nature: 14 hand-crafted minimal diagnostic snippets (156-448 chars) testing 7 failure modes

discrepancy_analysis.discrepancy_identified: M21 reported ~1,924 chars for B2 (70.4% reduction from 6,499 chars), whereas M22 reported 4,275 chars for both B0 and B2 (0.0% reduction).

root_causes.title: Different Evaluation Datasets and Pipeline Stages
root_causes.detail: Milestone 21 evaluated live corpus retrieval against 2,000+ Supreme Court judgments, where retrieved candidate passages were long judicial paragraphs (1,500-2,500 chars). Milestone 22 Phase B evaluated 14 hand-crafted minimal diagnostic snippets specifically created to test 7 qualification failure modes.

root_causes.title: Sentence Compressor Bypass on Short Passages
root_causes.detail: In ExtractiveSentenceCompressor.compress_passage (services/rag/evidence.py:442), if a passage contains <=2 sentences or is already below the character budget (max_chars=700), it is returned unmodified to prevent over-truncation. Because all 14 diagnostic snippets had <=2 sentences and totaled 156-448 chars per case, the compressor returned them intact, yielding exactly 4,275 characters in both B0 and B2.

root_causes.title: Heuristic Token Estimation vs Real Tokenizer Counts
root_causes.detail: Milestones 21 and 22 labeled token counts using 'evidence_chars / 4.0' rather than an actual tokenizer. On formal Indian Supreme Court legal prose, actual BGE/MiniLM tokenization yields 5.07 characters per token, meaning the character/4.0 heuristic systematically overstates actual token usage by ~26.8%.

discrepancy_analysis.conclusion: The 70.4% compression reported in M21 is genuine for live multi-passage corpus retrieval. The 0.0% compression in M22 reflects safe preservation behavior on already-compact diagnostic snippets. Sentence compression does not prune text when evidence is already below the budget threshold.

supported_precision.rule: Gold supported claims predicted as supported divided by all predicted supported claims

supported_recall.rule: Gold supported claims predicted as supported divided by total gold supported claims

supported_f1.rule: Harmonic mean of supported precision and recall

non_supported_far.rule: Proportion of non-supported claims falsely accepted into the supported class

contradiction_far.rule: Contradicted claims falsely accepted as supported

partially_supported_far.rule: Partially supported claims falsely accepted as supported

unsupported_far.rule: Unsupported claims falsely accepted as supported

false_rejection_rate.rule: Gold supported claims rejected or downgraded into unsupported/contradicted/not_evaluated

not_evaluated_rate.rule: Claims where verifier deferred decision due to low confidence or ambiguity

safe_presentation_compliance.rule: Claims where non-supported claims are never predicted as supported

answer_level_false_verification_rate.rule: Whole answers receiving 'verified_supported' badge when containing gold non-supported content
answer_level_false_verification_rate.qualification_note: Under multi-claim aggregation with fail-closed presentation rules, answers with partial support receive 'qualified_answer', contradictions receive 'rejected_answer'. However, in isolated single-claim answers without other safeguards, the 5 claim-level false acceptances would directly propagate to verified_supported.

independent_review_readiness_checklist.title: Reviewer Credentials and Independence
independent_review_readiness_checklist.instruction: Ensure reviewer is a qualified advocate, judicial law clerk, or legal scholar with no prior involvement in NyayaVarta prompt engineering, rule creation, or gold annotation.

independent_review_readiness_checklist.title: Blinded Examination of Proposition
independent_review_readiness_checklist.instruction: Inspect claim_under_review against exact_source_passage and surrounding_context without accessing system prompt, model identity, or predicted status.

independent_review_readiness_checklist.title: Strict Categorization
independent_review_readiness_checklist.instruction: Assign exactly one verdict from: ['supported', 'partially_supported', 'unsupported', 'contradicted', 'not_evaluated'] as defined in docs/MILESTONE_16_LEGAL_REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md.

independent_review_readiness_checklist.title: Documenting Exceptions and Missing Qualifications
independent_review_readiness_checklist.instruction: If assigning 'partially_supported', explicitly record the missing statutory proviso, limiting rule, or procedural caveat in reviewer_identified_caveat.

independent_review_readiness_checklist.title: Disagreement and Ambiguity Handling
independent_review_readiness_checklist.instruction: Flag cases where Supreme Court benches differ or where judgment context is inconclusive using reviewer_requires_more_context: true.

rationale: External legal review remains strictly PENDING_EXTERNAL_REVIEW with 0 independent advocate annotations.
Policy 3 retains a 16.67% claim-level non-supported false acceptance rate (4 partial + 1 contradiction false acceptances out of 30 non-supported claims).
Local CPU live generation is feasible on compact models (Qwen 0.5B at ~5.5s), but larger models (Phi-3.5 at ~22s) exhibit CPU latency constraints.
Llama 3.2 1B demonstrates conservative RLHF refusals on legal queries.
NyayaVarta must remain restricted to supervised internal developer research.
